samples.question: The image shows two colored loops, one red and one blue, drawn on a white background. Exactly one of the loops is a fully closed ring: the white region enclosed by its band is a sealed white region (a pocket) that has no opening at all to the surrounding white -- you cannot reach it from the outside without crossing the loop. The other loop is an open ring arc that has one wide visible gap, so the white region inside its curvature is open to the surrounding white through that gap. Look at the red loop and the blue loop. One of them is a complete closed ring whose inside is cut off from the surrounding white (a closed pocket); the other is open with a clear gap. Which colored loop is the closed one that walls off its interior from the outside? Answer with exactly red or blue.
